Card Q&A.a: Yes, it does. If there are 3 or more total Digimon between you and your opponent, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -12000 DP.
Card Q&A.q: Does "if there are 3 or more Digimon" in this card's [Main] effect count both my Digimon and my opponent's Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: If the conditions are met, the -6000 DP effect will further get -6000 DP for a total reduction of -12000 DP for 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: What does "it further gets -6000 DP" in this card's [Main] effect mean, exactly?

Effect: [Main] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -6000 DP for the turn. If there are 3 or more Digimon, it further gets -6000 DP.
